about.en: StablecoinX bStock (USDEB) is a tokenized share of StablecoinX Inc. issued by BTECH Holdings Ltd, a special purpose vehicle registered in the Abu Dhabi Global Market (ADGM), under Binance's bStocks brand. It is a BEP-20 token on BNB Chain at 0xdfd3ba51d4591f243481a6f26059d1a5ee95252f, backed 1:1 by USDE shares and convertible 1:1 with the underlying equity, with stock splits and dividend adjustments processed by the issuer. The underlying USDE is StablecoinX's Nasdaq-listed common stock, not Ethena's USDe stablecoin. bStocks are offered under an ADGM-approved prospectus and not in other jurisdictions.
